title: Weak-* convergence of the gradients of uniformly convergent, uniformly Lipschitz functions on ℝ^N (supplied step 4(d))
statement: Let N ∈ ℕ and Λ ≥ 0. Let u_k (k ∈ ℕ) and u be Λ-Lipschitz functions ℝ^N → ℝ (ℝ^N = Euclid N, Lebesgue measure L^N = volume) with u_k → u uniformly on ℝ^N. Let W : ℝ^N → ℝ^N be Lebesgue integrable. Then ∫ Du_k(y)(W(y)) dy → ∫ Du(y)(W(y)) dy as k → ∞, where Df(y) := fderiv ℝ f y, which is 0 where f is not differentiable.
lean_statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (us : ℕ → Euclid N → ℝ) (u : Euclid N → ℝ) (Λ : NNReal) (W : Euclid N → Euclid N), (∀ k, LipschitzWith Λ (us k)) → LipschitzWith Λ u → TendstoUniformly us u atTop → Integrable W → Tendsto (fun k => ∫ y, fderiv ℝ (us k) y (W y)) atTop (𝓝 (∫ y, fderiv ℝ u y (W y)))
